- Add code to use IORING_RECV_MULTISHOT
- Fix bug related to cancellations that are inflight

timeline.author: Norman Maurer

timeline.body:
Motivation:

To reduce overhead we should use IORING_RECV_MULTISHOT when possible.

Modifications:

- Add code to use IORING_RECV_MULTISHOT
- Fix bug related to cancellations that are inflight

Result:

Be able to use IORING_RECV_MULTISHOT to reduce overhead if kernel supports it
This was much harder then what I expected... the state machine is quite complex due the possibilities of cancellations that are in-flight

Regardless being supported: do we want to be able to test with/without it?
OR we would rely on running tests against different OS version which support it/or not?

reply.body: Yes... this is on my to do list as I want to test with different configs
